summary: 在语义修补前报告移除被拒操作后才会新增的指令覆盖缺口；保持当前missing语义、原范围、两轮预算和全部授权校验。
confirmed_facts: 原B14最后repair前当前missing为空；语义拒绝operation 1实际占据message 6第二条命令。移除该操作才使span [526,559)缺失。
既有REPAIR_SCOPE允许修改operation 1、追加来自message 6的操作；无需编辑正确operation 0或扩大范围。
原四包在e9和新候选下都仍然OPERATION_INTENT失败。新候选前三次模型调用的system/input哈希完全相同；第四次仅新增条件性反馈和对应prompt。
人工构造的改目标与remove+append两种最终patch均在两轮repair内通过原有局部校验，并触发新的独立语义核验，其scope严格为operation 1和message 6。未提供新核验响应即主动停止。
inference_and_limits: 已有两轮内具备提交正确patch的信息和权限；这证明可行修补存在，不能证明真实模型一定会采用它。
即使模型修正，仍需真实独立语义verdict及后续source-erasure和commit成功；本地测试没有证明真实恢复、服务写入成功或分数变化。
补丁不延长共享请求时间预算，不能保证后续模型阶段在剩余时间内完成。

implementation.entry: semantic verification findings -> scoped AT_RISK_OPERATION_INSTRUCTIONS -> next bounded PATCH_PROMPT
eligibility: Only explicit operation N semantic findings with an existing editable operation index.
Only obligations newly missing in a counterfactual proposal without those rejected operations.
Only active REPAIR_SCOPE.source_indices; exclude independently resolved source instructions.
A remaining non-rejected covering operation suppresses the warning. Message/fact findings do not declare scoped operations rejected.
preserved: No target selection or operation mutation by feedback helper.
No added repair rounds, expanded patch scope, merged instruction witnesses or fabricated authority.
Current MISSING_OPERATION_INSTRUCTIONS continues to mean already missing.
Changed operations require a fresh semantic verifier response; unchanged certificates may be reused.
